meta.name: Classify Plex music into smart playlists using Ollama and local LLMs

parameters.content:
## PlexPlaylister Version 1.4

## HOW IT WORKS

Creating Playlists can become quite a hassle as your Plex library grows. This workflow helps with automatically creating new Playlists and listen to music again that you have not heard in times.

## HOW TO SETUP

This flow has been developed for people that have their own instances of OLLAMA, n8n on a home NAS / media server. 

1. From the n8n Overview Page, go to Credentials 
- Setup global credentials to be used to authenticate for Plex 
   - Header 1
   - Name : X-Plex-Token; Value "MY_PLEX_TOKEN" see (https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/)";
   - Allowed HTTP Request Domains : All
- Setup OLLAMA Base URL  : test whether connectivity with OLLAMA is possible from the n8n instance
   - Optionally an OLLAMA cloud instance can be used but in that case the global credentials need to be added to authenticate for OLLAMA

2. In the PlaxPlaylister flow : 
Follow the STEPS adjusting the flow 
- Section 1 Change the Schedule Trigger : set the timing of when the flow should kick off. Take into account that a full run could take 24 hours.
- Section 2,3,6&7 Change ALL the HTTP Request nodes : change "MY_HOST_OR_IP" to your local IP of the Plex server 
- Section 4 Change the HTTP Request "Classify Tracks Using AI" node "MY_OLLAMA_HOST_OR_IP" to your local IP of the OLLAMA server


## CUSTOMIZATION

* While this template provides an out-of-the-box architecture for exhaustive, 100% coverage music classification using local LLMs (like gemma2:9b or mistral:7b), your final playlist accuracy depends heavily on two factors: ID3 Metadata Quality and Personalized Prompt Tuning.

If you 'd rather look at a video instruction I have embedded a video tutorial at the end of the workflow.

## 1. Set time/schedule your run 

This will allow scheduling the batch run  depending on how often you music collection is changing.

## 2 Collect Plex Library ID
Get the Library ID and prep for the further steps

## 3  Collect Music Library Info 
Fetch the track data untill all tracks have been collected

## 4 Classify Tracks into predefined Playlists 
In chuncks of data tracks will be offered to your local LLM for classification until all Playlist have been defined.

## 5 Collect the complete Playlists + Track lists
See the results of the Playlist creation and track coverage as output from STEP4.

## 6 Create the Playlists in Plex
Based on the output of STEP5 check the Plex Library and create the Playlist.

## 7 Populate the Playlists in Plex
Based on the output of STEP5 and STEP6 populate the Plex Playlist with the tracks classified.
Change the "MY_OLLAMA_HOST_OR_IP" HTTP Request in this node to your local IP of the OLLAMA server
